issues.title: Allow only one discount code per order
issues.body:
Today an order takes any number of discount codes, and their percents add up: `SAVE10` and `STAFF20` give 30% off. The shop allows one code per order. Refuse a second code in the request API and in the command line, and tell the customer which code the order already has.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `POST /orders/<id>/discounts` with a code, on an order that already has a different code, returns status 409 and `{"error": "discount_already_applied", "message": ...}`. The message names the code that the order already has.
- [ ] After that refusal, the order keeps only its first code, and its total does not change. This is also true when the data is read again.
- [ ] Adding the code that the order already has, in any case, still returns 200 and changes nothing.
- [ ] `python3 -m shop order discount <id> <code>` with a second code exits 1, and prints one line on stderr that starts with `error:` and names the code that the order already has.
- [ ] `docs/api.md` lists the new error.
